faq.question: What should I do if I have additional questions about logic circuits?
faq.answer: Use the Contact section in the navigation bar or email me directly. I can help with questions related to logic circuits, the binary system, Boolean algebra, and other topics covered in the app.

faq.question: How can I check how well I understood the material?
faq.answer: Take the course quiz under Final Step → Quiz. When you submit, your score and a question-by-question review (including correct answers for any mistakes) appear on the same page. Results stay on your device and are not uploaded to a server.

faq.question: How should I use the content in the app? What are the steps?
faq.answer: Start by exploring the 'Introduction to Logic Circuits' section to build foundational knowledge. Next, proceed through the 'Basic Concepts' and 'Gates' sections to understand the essential components. You can then test your understanding by using the 'Simulation' features and taking the quizzes in the 'Final Step' section. If you have further questions, use the Contact section.

faq.question: How can I contact you for further questions?
faq.answer: If you have further questions that are not covered by the app, you can reach out to me via the 'Contact' section available in the top navigation bar. I'm here to assist with any inquiries you may have.

faq.question: Is my quiz data private?
faq.answer: Yes. The quiz is graded in your browser only. Your answers and score are not sent to a server or stored in a database.

faq.question: Does the app store any personal information?
faq.answer: No. CircuLearn does not collect or store personally identifiable information. Quiz grading happens locally on your device.

faq.question: How do I use the quiz section?
faq.answer: Open Final Step → Quiz, answer all questions, confirm the consent statements, and submit. You will see your score and a detailed review of each question, including the correct answer for any you missed.

faq.question: After seeing all the learning sections, what should I do?
faq.answer: Take the Final Step quiz to check your understanding. Use the review on the results screen to revisit topics you missed, then explore the glossary or simulator for extra practice.
